approved.launchWindow: Official project launch and brokers briefing confirmed by Burtville. approved.brokerPriceNote: Impala's project page, checked 27 September 2026, advertises a base starting figure of AED 2.2m; Casadior advertises AED 2.37m. These are broker indications with different offer and inventory assumptions, not a verified current Burtville price list.
approved.paymentPlan: Impala reports 10/40/50, 20/40/40 and 30/40/30 alternatives, with incentives linked to the initial payment. Current developer schedules and offer eligibility are unverified.
approved.teaser: Burtville confirms a beachfront broker launch beside Reem Central Park.
approved.summary: Burtville has confirmed the official launch and brokers briefing for Bab Al Qasr Beach Resort Residence 77 on Al Reem Island, following earlier prelaunch marketing. The project offers fully furnished one- to three-bedroom residences and four- and five-bedroom duplex penthouses in three towers, with direct beach access and a connected Beach Club. Its location is on Bilshu'oum Street beside Reem Central Park; amenities include pools, a spa, fitness facilities, padel and a 650-metre walking and jogging track. The developer targets Q4 2031 handover; current prices, payment incentives and EOI terms still await a verified sales pack.
